extracted.name: Baileys tiramisu martini
extracted.description: Delight in this Baileys tiramisu martini, a velvety mix of Baileys Chocolate Liqueur, coffee liqueur, and vanilla vodka, topped with cocoa and a savoiardi biscuit to garnish for a rich, dessert-inspired cocktail experience.
instruction_lines: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice and add the Baileys Chocolate Liqueur, espresso, coffee liqueur, vodka and cream. Shake until the outside of the shaker feels very cold. Strain into chilled martini glasses, and sieve over a dusting of cocoa to serve. Garnish with a savoiardi biscuit if you like.
